QuestInfo.name: Doll in the Dark 1
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1012109##k of #b#m100000000##k in Victoria Island has apparently started writing a book.
QuestInfo.1: #p1012109# of #m100000000# has requested my help in writing his book. For more information, he recommended me to talk to #b#p2041022##k in #b#m220000400##k of Ludibrium. Should I go there...?
QuestInfo.2: #b#p2041022##k asked me to look for some subjects worthy of writing a book on. I should talk to him when the research is over.

0.0: Thank you so much for bringing that Maple History Book the other day. Actually since then, #p2041022# asked me if I could compile some data missing from the history book and write a new book on it. Ah! This is going to be a long story, so please be seated.
0.1: Well, I've run into a problem here. I was able to compile enough data for the missing information on Book 1 and 2 for the new book, but Book 3... the book on Monsters. That's the one I'm still terribly lacking on.
0.2: It's a stretch to find every single information from the book, and... I would really love to face them myself, if only I could, but I'm not strong enough to face them.
0.3: Can you please help me out here? I would personally like to request a little help from you, for the sake of the book.

yes.0: Thank you so much! I'm currently researching the doll monsters, but I have no clue exactly which monster I'm supposed to study on. I'm sure someone like #b#p2041022##k may give you an advise on this.
yes.1: Please meet #b#p2041022##k at #b#m220000400##k of Ludibrium, and ask him what I should research on.

no.0: I see... then do you have someone you can recommend? Please help me... if only I was strong enough to take on the monsters myself...

1.0: Ahhh, you're the one with the History Book... it's been a while. Good seeing you. What? #b#p1012109##k is struggling to write a book as we speak?

yes.0: Doll monsters? Well, you'll find some at the Eos Tower. I don't know exactly which one will help him write his book. Alright, I'll look for some information on this. Can you give me some time? Talk to me later, okay?

npc.0: If you go see #b#p2041022##k, he may give you helpful advice about this.
